// Narrow public acquisition/fault/cancellation checks; full capability is separate.
func TestLifecycleProfileModelDiagnostic(t *testing.T) { runModelDiagnostic(t,"model_diagnostic") }
func TestLifecycleProfileModelFaultDiagnostic(t *testing.T) { runModelDiagnostic(t,"model_fault_diagnostic") }
func TestLifecycleProfileModelCancelDiagnostic(t *testing.T) { runModelDiagnostic(t,"model_cancel_diagnostic") }
func runModelDiagnostic(t *testing.T,mode string) {
 if testing.Short(){t.Skip("dedicated public Models acquisition diagnostic")}
 r:=newSampleProfile(mode);defer r.emit(t);r.load(t)
 baselineobservation.Close();defer baselineobservation.Close()
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(t.Context(),time.Minute);defer cancel()
 r.session(t,ctx,smokeArtifact(t))
}

func checkModelDiagnosticResult(mode,text string,result sessions.InvocationResult,err error)error {
 if err!=nil{return err}
 expected:=sessions.InvocationTerminalStatusCompleted;code:=""
 if text=="profile-model-peer" {
  if mode=="model_fault_diagnostic"{expected=sessions.InvocationTerminalStatusFailed;code=string(sessions.InvocationErrorCodeRuntimeFailure)}
  if mode=="model_cancel_diagnostic"{expected=sessions.InvocationTerminalStatusCanceled;code=string(sessions.InvocationErrorCodeCanceled)}
 }
 if result.Status!=expected || result.ErrorCode!=code || result.RequestID!=text || result.TraceID==""{return fmt.Errorf("unexpected public model outcome: %#v",result)}
 return nil
}
func TestLifecycleProfileDriverModelDiagnosticOutcomes(t *testing.T) {
 t.Parallel()
 for _,mode:=range []string{"model_diagnostic","model_fault_diagnostic","model_cancel_diagnostic"}{
  result:=sessions.InvocationResult{RequestID:"profile-model-peer",TraceID:"trace",Status:sessions.InvocationTerminalStatusCompleted}
  if mode=="model_fault_diagnostic"{result.Status=sessions.InvocationTerminalStatusFailed;result.ErrorCode=string(sessions.InvocationErrorCodeRuntimeFailure)}
  if mode=="model_cancel_diagnostic"{result.Status=sessions.InvocationTerminalStatusCanceled;result.ErrorCode=string(sessions.InvocationErrorCodeCanceled)}
  if err:=checkModelDiagnosticResult(mode,result.RequestID,result,nil);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  wrong:=result;wrong.Status=sessions.InvocationTerminalStatusTimedOut
  if checkModelDiagnosticResult(mode,result.RequestID,wrong,nil)==nil{t.Fatal("timeout accepted as declared outcome")}
  wrong=result;wrong.TraceID="";if checkModelDiagnosticResult(mode,result.RequestID,wrong,nil)==nil{t.Fatal("unattributed outcome accepted")}
  cause:=errors.New("transport failed");if !errors.Is(checkModelDiagnosticResult(mode,result.RequestID,result,cause),cause){t.Fatal("original transport failure lost")}
 }
}

func profileModelFactory(t *testing.T)string {
 t.Helper();folder:=t.TempDir()
 config:=`{"name":"profile-model","workTypes":[{"name":"task","handlingBehavior":["DEFAULT"],"states":[{"name":"init","type":"INITIAL"},{"name":"complete","type":"TERMINAL"},{"name":"failed","type":"FAILED"}]}],"resources":[{"name":"embed-cache","type":"MODEL","capacity":2,"model":"embed","backend":"localai-llamacpp","loadPolicy":"ON_DEMAND"}],"invocationSignature":{"parameters":[{"name":"text","required":true,"bindings":[{"kind":"POSITIONAL","position":1},{"kind":"STDIN"}]}]},"workers":[{"name":"embed-worker","type":"MODEL_WORKER","model":"embed","modelLocality":"LOCAL","modelProvider":"CODEX","resources":[{"name":"embed-cache","capacity":1}],"operations":[{"name":"EMBED","inputs":[{"name":"text","required":true,"contentTypes":["TEXT"]}],"outputs":[{"name":"embedding","contentTypes":["JSON"]}]}]}],"workstations":[{"name":"embed","type":"MODEL_INVOKE","worker":"embed-worker","operation":"EMBED","operationBindings":[{"slot":"text","selector":{"type":"TEXT"}}],"inputs":[{"workType":"task","state":"init"}],"outputs":[{"workType":"task","state":"complete"}],"onFailure":[{"workType":"task","state":"failed"}]}]}`
 if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(folder,"factory.json"),[]byte(config),0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 workstation:=filepath.Join(folder,"workstations","embed");if err:=os.MkdirAll(workstation,0700);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(workstation,"AGENTS.md"),[]byte("---\ntype: MODEL_INVOKE\n---\nEmbed the selected text.\n"),0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 return folder
}

func (r *sampleProfile) modelDiagnostic(t *testing.T,ctx context.Context,service sessions.Service,home string,artifact artifactIdentity,bootstrap []string,gate *profileModelGate) {
 folder:=profileModelFactory(t);id:=uuid.NewString();ops:=publicCycleOperations(service,home,folder)
 cycle:=&profileCycle{SessionID:id,Generations:[]string{},RuntimeIDs:[]string{}}
 defer func(){cleanup,stop:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),30*time.Second);defer stop();gate.release("profile-model-work");if err:=ops.Close(cleanup,cycle);err!=nil{r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,err.Error());t.Error(err)}}()
 generation,runtimeID,err:=ops.Open(ctx,cycle,false);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};cycle.Generations=append(cycle.Generations,generation);cycle.RuntimeIDs=append(cycle.RuntimeIDs,runtimeID)
 routes:=[]string{"profile-model-work","profile-model-peer"}
 peerCtx,cancelPeer:=context.WithCancel(ctx);defer cancelPeer()
 done:=make(chan error,2);started,joined:=0,0
 defer func(){
  cleanup,stop:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),30*time.Second);defer stop()
  for _,text:=range routes{gate.release(text)}
  for joined<started{select{case err:=<-done:joined++;if err!=nil{r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,err.Error());t.Error(err)};case <-cleanup.Done():r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,"public model Work not joined");t.Error("public model Work not joined");return}}
  for _,text:=range routes[:started]{if err:=gate.join(cleanup,text);err!=nil{r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,err.Error());t.Error(err)}}
 }()
 var scope string
 for _,text:=range routes {
  started++
  go func(){invokeCtx:=ctx;if text=="profile-model-peer"{invokeCtx=peerCtx};result,err:=service.Invoke(invokeCtx,sessions.SessionInvokeRequest{SessionID:id,Correlation:sessions.SessionOperationCorrelation{RequestID:text},ContentProvided:true,Content:[]work.WorkContentPart{{Type:work.WorkContentPartTypeText,Text:text}},Wait:sessions.SessionOperationWait{TimeoutMillis:30000}});t.Logf("public model outcome mode=%s route=%s result=%#v error=%v",r.Mode,text,result,err);done<-checkModelDiagnosticResult(r.Mode,text,result,err)}()
  // Observe terminal refusal as well as acquisition; a held peer cannot return.
  select{case request:=<-gate.routes[text].observed:
   if scope!="" && scope!=request.Scope.String(){t.Fatal("public model Work changed scope")};scope=request.Scope.String()
  case err=<-done:joined++;t.Fatalf("Work ended before acquisition: %v",err)
  case <-ctx.Done():t.Fatal(ctx.Err())}
 }
 attempt:=&profileAttempt{SessionID:&id,Generations:cycle.Generations}
 active:=r.capture(t,artifact,"CAPACITY_ACTIVE",attempt,bootstrap);r.Final=append(r.Final,active)
 slot:=scope+"|EMBED";leaseIDs:=map[string]bool{};ownerID:=""
 for _,owner:=range active.Report.Owners{if owner.Leases!=nil && owner.Leases.CapacityHolders[slot]==2{
  if ownerID!=""{t.Fatal("duplicate Models capacity owner")};ownerID=owner.OwnerIdentity
  for _,lease:=range owner.Leases.LeaseRecords{if lease.Scope==scope && lease.ModelName=="embed" && lease.Status=="ACTIVE" && lease.Claimed{if leaseIDs[lease.Key]{t.Fatal("duplicate active lease")};leaseIDs[lease.Key]=true}}
 }}
 if len(leaseIDs)!=2 || ownerID==""{t.Fatal("missing two real same-slot Models capacity holders")}
 if r.Mode=="model_cancel_diagnostic" {
  if err=gate.release(routes[0]);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  select{case err=<-done:joined++;if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};case <-ctx.Done():t.Fatal(ctx.Err())}
  if err=ops.Cancel(ctx,cycle);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  cancelPeer() // Cancel the owned caller wait after the public stop joined.
 } else {for _,text:=range routes{if err=gate.release(text);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}}
 for joined<started{select{case err=<-done:joined++;if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};case <-ctx.Done():t.Fatal(ctx.Err())}}
 for _,text:=range routes{if err=gate.join(ctx,text);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
 released:=r.capture(t,artifact,"CAPACITY_RELEASED",attempt,bootstrap);r.Final=append(r.Final,released)
 found:=0
 for _,owner:=range released.Report.Owners{if owner.OwnerIdentity!=ownerID{continue};if owner.Leases.CapacityHolders[slot]!=0{t.Fatal("capacity remained held after terminal Works")};for _,lease:=range owner.Leases.LeaseRecords{if leaseIDs[lease.Key] && (lease.Status=="RELEASED" || lease.Status=="EXPIRED"){found++}}}
 if found!=2{t.Fatal("released lease records missing or active")}
 t.Logf("composed public acquisition session=%s scope=%s owner=%s slot=%s leases=%v; two holders, public capacity=2",id,scope,ownerID,slot,leaseIDs)
}

// Installed only at ModelInvocationBackend, after the real Models owner has
// acquired capacity. Calling this component directly is synthetic calibration,
// never a composed capacity witness. Routes are immutable after construction.
type profileModelGate struct {
 mu sync.Mutex
 routes map[string]*profileModelRoute
 scope string
}

type profileModelRoute struct {
 observed chan models.InvokeModelRequest
 release chan struct{}
 returned chan struct{}
 once sync.Once
 entered bool // guarded by profileModelGate.mu
 failure error
}

func newProfileModelGate(failures map[string]error)(*profileModelGate,error) {
 if len(failures)==0{return nil,fmt.Errorf("model gate requires declared Work routes")}
 gate:=&profileModelGate{routes:map[string]*profileModelRoute{}}
 for text,failure:=range failures {
  if text==""{return nil,fmt.Errorf("empty model Work route")}
  gate.routes[text]=&profileModelRoute{observed:make(chan models.InvokeModelRequest,1),release:make(chan struct{}),returned:make(chan struct{}),failure:failure}
 }
 return gate,nil
}

func detachedModelGateRequest(request models.InvokeModelRequest) models.InvokeModelRequest {
 request.Inputs=append([]models.InferenceInput(nil),request.Inputs...)
 for i:=range request.Inputs{if ref:=request.Inputs[i].Artifact;ref!=nil{copy:=*ref;request.Inputs[i].Artifact=&copy}}
 if request.Input.Artifact!=nil{copy:=*request.Input.Artifact;request.Input.Artifact=&copy}
 request.Parameters=append([]models.OperationParameter(nil),request.Parameters...)
 for i:=range request.Parameters{request.Parameters[i]=request.Parameters[i].Clone()}
 return request
}

func (g *profileModelGate) invoke(ctx context.Context,request models.InvokeModelRequest)([]models.InferenceContent,[]models.InferenceArtifact,error) {
 if err:=ctx.Err();err!=nil{return nil,nil,err}
 if request.Scope.IsZero() || request.ModelName!="embed" || request.Operation!=models.OperationEMBED || len(request.Inputs)!=1 || request.Inputs[0].Name!="text" {
  return nil,nil,fmt.Errorf("unexpected scoped EMBED effect")
 }
 g.mu.Lock()
 route:=g.routes[request.Inputs[0].Content]
 if route==nil || route.entered {g.mu.Unlock();return nil,nil,fmt.Errorf("unexpected or repeated model Work route")}
 scope:=request.Scope.String()
 if g.scope!="" && g.scope!=scope {g.mu.Unlock();return nil,nil,fmt.Errorf("model Work routes changed explicit session scope")}
 g.scope=scope;route.entered=true
 g.mu.Unlock()
 defer close(route.returned)
 // Buffered observation cannot prevent cancellation or cleanup. Copy all
 // reference-bearing input/parameter values before publishing the observation.
 route.observed<-detachedModelGateRequest(request)
 select{case <-route.release:case <-ctx.Done():return nil,nil,ctx.Err()}
 if err:=ctx.Err();err!=nil{return nil,nil,err}
 if route.failure!=nil{return nil,nil,route.failure}
 return []models.InferenceContent{{Name:"embedding",Modality:models.ModalityJSON,ContentType:"application/json",MediaType:"application/json",Content:"[101]"}},nil,nil
}

func (g *profileModelGate) accepted(ctx context.Context,text string)(models.InvokeModelRequest,error) {
 route:=g.routes[text]
 if route==nil{return models.InvokeModelRequest{},fmt.Errorf("undeclared model Work route")}
 select{case request:=<-route.observed:return request,nil;case <-ctx.Done():return models.InvokeModelRequest{},ctx.Err()}
}

func (g *profileModelGate) release(text string)error {
 route:=g.routes[text];if route==nil{return fmt.Errorf("undeclared model Work route")}
 route.once.Do(func(){close(route.release)})
 return nil
}

// The backend-return barrier precedes the public terminal Work barrier. A
// caller must join both before CAPACITY_RELEASED; this alone proves no release.
func (g *profileModelGate) join(ctx context.Context,text string)error {
 route:=g.routes[text];if route==nil{return fmt.Errorf("undeclared model Work route")}
 select{case <-route.returned:return nil;case <-ctx.Done():return ctx.Err()}
}

func modelGateUnitRequest(t *testing.T,text,scope string) models.InvokeModelRequest {
 t.Helper();ref,err:=(models.RuntimeScopeRef{}).Parse(scope);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 return models.InvokeModelRequest{Scope:ref,ModelName:"embed",Operation:models.OperationEMBED,Inputs:[]models.InferenceInput{{Name:"text",Content:text}},Parameters:[]models.OperationParameter{{Name:"nested",Value:map[string]any{"values":[]any{"original"}}}}}
}

func TestLifecycleProfileDriverModelGateHeldMultiplicity(t *testing.T) {
 t.Parallel()
 gate,err:=newProfileModelGate(map[string]error{"first":nil,"second":nil});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 // These are component callbacks, not Models acquisitions or a public journey.
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithCancel(t.Context());defer cancel()
 done:=make(chan error,2)
 for _,text:=range []string{"first","second"} {
  request:=modelGateUnitRequest(t,text,"synthetic-scope")
  go func(){content,artifacts,err:=gate.invoke(ctx,request);if err==nil && (len(content)!=1 || content[0].Content!="[101]" || len(artifacts)!=0){err=errors.New("wrong controlled output")};done<-err}()
  observed,err:=gate.accepted(ctx,text);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  if observed.Scope.String()!="synthetic-scope" || observed.Inputs[0].Content!=text{t.Fatal("lost route attribution")}
  select{case <-done:t.Fatal("held effect returned before release");default:}
 }
 for _,text:=range []string{"first","second"}{if err=gate.release(text);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};if err=gate.release(text);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
 for range 2{if err=<-done;err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
 for _,text:=range []string{"first","second"}{if err=gate.join(ctx,text);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
}

func TestLifecycleProfileDriverModelGateFaultAndCancellation(t *testing.T) {
 t.Parallel()
 fault:=models.ErrInferenceTimeout
 for _,mode:=range []string{"fault","cancel"}{t.Run(mode,func(t *testing.T){
  gate,err:=newProfileModelGate(map[string]error{"work":fault});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  ctx,cancel:=context.WithCancel(t.Context());defer cancel()
  done:=make(chan error,1);request:=modelGateUnitRequest(t,"work","synthetic-scope")
  go func(){_,_,err:=gate.invoke(ctx,request);done<-err}()
  if _,err=gate.accepted(ctx,"work");err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  want:=fault;if mode=="cancel"{cancel();want=context.Canceled}else{if err=gate.release("work");err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
  if err=<-done;!errors.Is(err,want){t.Fatalf("lost cause: %v, want %v",err,want)}
  if err=gate.join(t.Context(),"work");err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 })}
}

func TestLifecycleProfileDriverModelGateRejectsInvalidEffects(t *testing.T) {
 t.Parallel()
 for _,change:=range []func(*models.InvokeModelRequest){
  func(r *models.InvokeModelRequest){r.Scope=models.RuntimeScopeRef{}},
  func(r *models.InvokeModelRequest){r.ModelName="peer"},func(r *models.InvokeModelRequest){r.Operation="TTS"},
  func(r *models.InvokeModelRequest){r.Inputs=nil},func(r *models.InvokeModelRequest){r.Inputs[0].Name="audio"},
  func(r *models.InvokeModelRequest){r.Inputs[0].Content="undeclared"},
 }{
  gate,err:=newProfileModelGate(map[string]error{"work":nil});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  request:=modelGateUnitRequest(t,"work","synthetic-scope");change(&request)
  if _,_,err=gate.invoke(t.Context(),request);err==nil{t.Fatal("invalid effect accepted")}
  select{case <-gate.routes["work"].observed:t.Fatal("invalid request published acquisition");default:}
 }
 gate,err:=newProfileModelGate(map[string]error{"work":nil,"peer":nil});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err=gate.release("work");err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if _,_,err=gate.invoke(t.Context(),modelGateUnitRequest(t,"work","synthetic-scope"));err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 for _,request:=range []models.InvokeModelRequest{modelGateUnitRequest(t,"work","synthetic-scope"),modelGateUnitRequest(t,"peer","other-scope")} {
  if _,_,err=gate.invoke(t.Context(),request);err==nil{t.Fatal("duplicate/foreign-scope effect accepted")}
 }
 for _,routes:=range []map[string]error{nil,{"":nil}}{if _,err=newProfileModelGate(routes);err==nil{t.Fatal("invalid route declaration accepted")}}
 for _,operation:=range []func()error{func()error{return gate.release("absent")},func()error{return gate.join(t.Context(),"absent")},func()error{_,err:=gate.accepted(t.Context(),"absent");return err}}{if operation()==nil{t.Fatal("unknown route accepted")}}
 canceled,stop:=context.WithCancel(t.Context());stop()
 if _,_,err=gate.invoke(canceled,modelGateUnitRequest(t,"peer","synthetic-scope"));!errors.Is(err,context.Canceled){t.Fatal("lost pre-admission cancellation",err)}
 if _,err=gate.accepted(canceled,"peer");!errors.Is(err,context.Canceled){t.Fatal("canceled acceptance wait",err)}
 if err=gate.join(canceled,"peer");!errors.Is(err,context.Canceled){t.Fatal("missing return barrier guessed joined",err)}
}

func TestLifecycleProfileDriverModelGateDetachedObservation(t *testing.T) {
 t.Parallel()
 gate,err:=newProfileModelGate(map[string]error{"work":nil});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 request:=modelGateUnitRequest(t,"work","synthetic-scope")
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithCancel(t.Context());defer cancel()
 done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){_,_,err:=gate.invoke(ctx,request);done<-err}()
 observed,err:=gate.accepted(ctx,"work");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 request.Inputs[0].Content="changed"
 request.Parameters[0].Value.(map[string]any)["values"].([]any)[0]="changed"
 if observed.Inputs[0].Content!="work" || observed.Parameters[0].Value.(map[string]any)["values"].([]any)[0]!="original"{t.Fatal("observation aliases caller data")}
 if err=gate.release("work");err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err=<-done;err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
}

// The controlled host implements only the external process lifetime. Models
// still owns readiness, acquisition, release and retained lease disposition.
type profileModelHost struct { endpoint string; stopped chan struct{}; once sync.Once }
func (h *profileModelHost) HealthEndpoint()string{return h.endpoint}
func (h *profileModelHost) Wait()error{<-h.stopped;return nil}
func (h *profileModelHost) Stop(ctx context.Context)error{
 if err:=ctx.Err();err!=nil{return err};h.once.Do(func(){close(h.stopped)});return nil
}
type profileModelEffects struct {endpoint string}
func (e profileModelEffects) Start(ctx context.Context,_ edges.HostProcessStartSpec)(interface{HealthEndpoint()string;Wait()error;Stop(context.Context)error},error){
 if err:=ctx.Err();err!=nil{return nil,err}
 return &profileModelHost{endpoint:e.endpoint,stopped:make(chan struct{})},nil
}
func (e profileModelEffects) Negotiate(ctx context.Context,endpoint string,r edges.ModelHostProtocolNegotiationRequest)(edges.ModelHostProtocolNegotiationResult,error){
 if err:=ctx.Err();err!=nil{return edges.ModelHostProtocolNegotiationResult{},err}
 if endpoint!=e.endpoint || r.Backend!="localai-llamacpp"{return edges.ModelHostProtocolNegotiationResult{},fmt.Errorf("unexpected controlled model protocol")}
 return edges.ModelHostProtocolNegotiationResult{ProtocolVersion:"localai-backend-v1",Backend:r.Backend,Ready:true},nil
}
func (profileModelEffects) Check(ctx context.Context,_ edges.ModelHostCompatibilityRequest)error{return ctx.Err()}
type profileRejectModelNetwork struct{}
func (profileRejectModelNetwork) Do(r *http.Request)(*http.Response,error){return nil,fmt.Errorf("profile forbids model download: %s",r.URL)}

// Author the same content-addressed cache contract used by the existing public
// Models fixture. These bytes are inert substitutes, never real model assets.
func profileModelCache(home,kind,source,name string,body []byte)(string,error){
 digest:=fmt.Sprintf("%x",sha256.Sum256(body))
 identity:=fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%s:%d:%s",kind,source,name,len(body),digest)
 base:=filepath.Join(home,".agent-factory","models")
 if kind=="backend"{base=filepath.Join(base,"backend-artifacts")}
 folder:=filepath.Join(base,".you-content-addressed",kind,fmt.Sprintf("%x",sha256.Sum256([]byte(identity))))
 if err:=os.MkdirAll(folder,0700);err!=nil{return "",err}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(folder,name),body,0600);err!=nil{return "",err}
 data,err:=json.Marshal(map[string]any{"kind":kind,"identity":identity,"source":source,"sourceKey":source,"artifacts":[]map[string]any{{"Name":name,"Bytes":len(body),"SHA256":digest}}})
 if err!=nil{return "",err};return folder,os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(folder,".you-assets.json"),data,0600)
}

func profileModelEdges(t *testing.T,home string,gate *profileModelGate)edges.Edges{
 t.Helper()
 host:=httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter,r *http.Request){if r.URL.Path=="/health"{w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK);return};http.NotFound(w,r)}))
 t.Cleanup(host.Close)
 definition,ok:=(models.BuiltInCatalog{}).ModelDefinitionFor("embed");if !ok{t.Fatal("source lacks built-in embed model")}
 name:=filepath.Base(definition.Source);for i,c:=range name{if c=='@'{name=name[:i];break}}
 if _,err:=profileModelCache(home,"model",definition.Source,name,[]byte("controlled profile embedding weights"));err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 body:=[]byte("controlled profile backend")
 selection:=edges.ModelBackendArtifactSelection{Name:"profile-backend.tar.gz",Location:"https://github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/releases/download/profile-fixture/profile-backend.tar.gz",Bytes:int64(len(body)),SHA256:fmt.Sprintf("%x",sha256.Sum256(body))}
 source:="backend://localai-llamacpp/release://"+fmt.Sprintf("%x",sha256.Sum256([]byte(selection.Location)))
 if _,err:=profileModelCache(home,"backend",source,selection.Name,body);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 effects:=profileModelEffects{endpoint:host.URL}
 return edges.Edges{
 ModelAssetHTTPClient:profileRejectModelNetwork{},ModelAssetHostPlatform:models.AssetHostPlatform{OperatingSystem:"linux",Architecture:"amd64"},
 ModelAssetResolveHomeDirectory:func()(string,error){return home,nil},ModelAssetResolveEnvironment:func(string)string{return ""},
 ModelAssetMakeDirectories:os.MkdirAll,ModelAssetInspectPath:os.Stat,ModelAssetWriteFile:os.WriteFile,ModelAssetRenamePath:os.Rename,ModelAssetRemovePath:os.Remove,
 ModelAssetReadFile:os.ReadFile,ModelAssetReadDirectory:os.ReadDir,ModelAssetCreateFile:func(p string)(io.WriteCloser,error){return os.Create(p)},ModelAssetOpenFile:func(p string)(io.ReadCloser,error){return os.Open(p)},
 ModelHostProcessLauncher:effects,ModelHostHTTPClient:host.Client(),ModelRuntimeHTTPClient:host.Client(),ModelHostProtocolNegotiator:effects,ModelHostCompatibilityChecker:effects,
 ModelResolveBackendArtifact:func(ctx context.Context,r edges.ModelBackendArtifactSelectionRequest)(edges.ModelBackendArtifactSelection,error){if err:=ctx.Err();err!=nil{return edges.ModelBackendArtifactSelection{},err};if r.Backend!="localai-llamacpp" || r.ProtocolVersion!="localai-backend-v1"{return edges.ModelBackendArtifactSelection{},fmt.Errorf("unexpected profile backend selection")};return selection,nil},
 ModelInvocationBackend:gate.invoke,
 }
}

func TestLifecycleProfileDriverControlledHostJoin(t *testing.T){
 t.Parallel();effects:=profileModelEffects{endpoint:"http://owned"}
 h,err:=effects.Start(t.Context(),edges.HostProcessStartSpec{});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-h.Wait()}()
 select{case <-done:t.Fatal("host wait did not hold lifetime");default:}
 canceled,stop:=context.WithCancel(t.Context());stop()
 if err=h.Stop(canceled);!errors.Is(err,context.Canceled){t.Fatal("lost stop cancellation",err)}
 select{case <-done:t.Fatal("failed stop claimed join");default:}
 if err=h.Stop(t.Context());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};if err=h.Stop(t.Context());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err=<-done;err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if _,err=effects.Start(canceled,edges.HostProcessStartSpec{});!errors.Is(err,context.Canceled){t.Fatal("lost launch cancellation",err)}
 if _,err=effects.Negotiate(t.Context(),"http://foreign",edges.ModelHostProtocolNegotiationRequest{Backend:"localai-llamacpp"});err==nil{t.Fatal("foreign host accepted")}
 request,_:=http.NewRequestWithContext(t.Context(),http.MethodGet,"https://profile.invalid/model",nil)
 if _,err=(profileRejectModelNetwork{}).Do(request);err==nil{t.Fatal("download permitted")}
}

func TestLifecycleProfileDriverModelFixtureEffects(t *testing.T){
 t.Parallel();gate,err:=newProfileModelGate(map[string]error{"work":nil});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 effect:=profileModelEdges(t,t.TempDir(),gate)
 selected,err:=effect.ModelResolveBackendArtifact(t.Context(),edges.ModelBackendArtifactSelectionRequest{Backend:"localai-llamacpp",ProtocolVersion:"localai-backend-v1"});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if selected.Bytes<1 || len(selected.SHA256)!=64{t.Fatal("missing cached fixture identity")}
 if _,err=effect.ModelResolveBackendArtifact(t.Context(),edges.ModelBackendArtifactSelectionRequest{Backend:"foreign"});err==nil{t.Fatal("foreign backend accepted")}
 canceled,stop:=context.WithCancel(t.Context());stop()
 if _,err=effect.ModelResolveBackendArtifact(canceled,edges.ModelBackendArtifactSelectionRequest{Backend:"localai-llamacpp",ProtocolVersion:"localai-backend-v1"});!errors.Is(err,context.Canceled){t.Fatal("lost selection cancellation",err)}
 home,err:=effect.ModelAssetResolveHomeDirectory();if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 folder,err:=profileModelCache(home,"model","fixture://owned","weights.bin",[]byte("inert"));if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 data,err:=effect.ModelAssetReadFile(filepath.Join(folder,"weights.bin"));if err!=nil || string(data)!="inert"{t.Fatal("cached bytes unavailable",err)}
 metadata,err:=effect.ModelAssetReadFile(filepath.Join(folder,".you-assets.json"));if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 var decoded struct{Identity string;Artifacts []struct{Name,SHA256 string;Bytes int}}
 if err=json.Unmarshal(metadata,&decoded);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if decoded.Identity=="" || len(decoded.Artifacts)!=1 || decoded.Artifacts[0].Bytes!=5 || decoded.Artifacts[0].SHA256!=fmt.Sprintf("%x",sha256.Sum256(data)){t.Fatal("cache lost content attribution")}
}
